B40.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

B40.why: 才 = only then (later than it should be).

B40.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.

C04.question: 他們把桌子搬到哪裡去？
C04.why: The table is carried into the yard → 院子裡. A and C are places inside the house.

C04.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
C04.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.
C04.question: 鞋子在哪裡？
C04.why: 在床底下. A is mentioned but rejected (不在門口). C is not mentioned.

C04.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the picture that answers the question.

lines.zh: 這座房子真大！有幾個臥室？

C04.question: 樓下有什麼？
C04.why: 樓下是客廳和廚房. A: the bedrooms are upstairs. C is not mentioned.

C04.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
C04.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the most suitable answer.

lines.zh: 媽，我可以把小狗帶到臥室去嗎？
那也不行，讓狗在院子裡玩吧。

C04.question: 媽媽的意思是什麼？
C04.why: 別帶到樓上去 + 那也不行 → the dog still may not go in the bedroom. A: the dog was just washed. B is not mentioned. D is the opposite.

C04.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
C04.text: 爸爸把新沙發放在客廳裡了。

options.label: a sofa in the living room

C04.why: 放在客廳裡 → the living room. B and C are other places.

C04.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
C04.why: A house with a yard → 有院子. A is the opposite; C is a tall building, not a house.

C04.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
C04.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
C04.text: 你的鞋子別放在床底下，把它們放（　）門口去。
C04.why: Pattern 把 O V到 + place + 去: 放到門口去. 放在門口去 is wrong because 在 does not combine with 去; 給 is for people.

C04.instr: Fill in each blank. Each option can be used only once, and ONE option is not used.
C04.text: 我們上個月搬到一（1）房子。一樓是客廳和廚房，（2），每個人都有自己的房間。房子前面還有（3），天氣好，我們就在那裡喝茶。搬家那天，我們把沙發放在客廳，把書桌（4）。最後大家都累了，我的小狗也累了，就在（5）睡覺。
C04.why: 一座兩層樓的房子; 二樓有三個臥室 → everyone has a room; 前面有一個小院子; 書桌放在窗戶旁邊; 小狗在床底下. 「廳裡沒有家具」 contradicts it: the sofa is put in the living room.

C04.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
C04.text: 王先生在找房子。他看了兩個地方：第一個房子在公車站旁邊，只有一層，兩個臥室，很方便，可是沒有院子。第二個房子離公車站比較遠，有兩層，四個臥房，旁邊還有一個大院子。王先生家有五個人，還有兩隻大狗，所以他最後決定住第二個。
C04.question: 王先生為什麼決定住第二個房子？
C04.why: 五個人 + 兩隻大狗 → they need 4 rooms & a yard. A: the opposite (第二個離捷運站比較遠). C: the price isn't mentioned. D: not mentioned.

C16.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
C16.question: 明天幾點開會？
C16.why: 9 a.m. in the meeting room → 九點. B and C are the wrong time.

C16.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: she says "no need to come"; her friend relaxes at home

C16.question: 我要來嗎？
C16.why: He says there's no need to come; his friend relaxes at home → 不用來. A is the opposite; C does not answer.

C16.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
C16.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.

lines.zh: 不用，昨天我已經把工作做完了。

C16.question: 這位先生今天要做什麼？
C16.why: 不用 (work late) + the work was finished yesterday → going home. A is the opposite; C: the work is already done.

C16.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the picture that answers the question.

lines.zh: 老闆要求我們每天寫報告嗎？
不是每天，一個星期寫一次。

C16.question: 什麼時候要交報告？
C16.why: 星期五下午. A is ruled out (不是每天). C is not mentioned.

C16.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
C16.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the most suitable answer.

lines.zh: 我明天必須去醫院看我媽媽。

C16.question: 明天誰可能會去開會？
C16.why: 請小林替你來 → 小林 may come. A has to go to hospital. B is unrelated. D does not fit.

C16.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
C16.text: 今天不用加班，他五點就回家了。

options.label: still at the office at night

C16.why: 不用加班 + 五點就回家 → at home at 5. B and C are still at the office.

C16.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
C16.why: People with a chart → 開會. A and C are other activities.

C16.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
C16.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.

picture.label: a report that must be handed in

C16.text: 明天早上以前，你（　）交報告。
C16.why: A 'must' sign → 必須交. 要求 needs a person as object (要求你交); 不用了 cannot be followed by a verb here.

C16.instr: Fill in each blank. Each option can be used only once, and ONE option is not used.
C16.text: 今天下午老闆說明天早上要（1），（2）每個人都準備一份報告。我的報告還沒寫完，所以今天晚上（3）。我打電話告訴太太，她說：「那你（4）回來吃晚飯了，我們先吃。」我十點才寫完，回到家的時候，孩子們（5）。
C16.why: 明天要開會; 要求每個人準備報告; the report isn't finished → 必須加班; 不必回來吃晚飯; home at 10 → the children 都已經睡覺了. 「報告很有意思」 doesn't fit anywhere.

C16.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
C16.text: 我們公司從下個月開始有新的要求：大家不必每天都到公司，一個星期來三天就可以了，其他兩天可以在家工作。可是每個星期一早上九點都要開會，不能來的人必須先告訴老闆。老闆說，這樣大家不用每天花很多時間坐車，工作的時候也會比較快樂。
C16.question: 老闆為什麼讓大家在家工作？
C16.why: 不用每天花很多時間坐車. A & D: not mentioned. B: the Monday meeting is still compulsory.

C24.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a typhoon outside, the family stays indoors

C24.question: 颱風來了，我們要做什麼？
C24.why: A typhoon outside, the family indoors → 別出門. A and C are dangerous.

C24.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a steaming hot spring pool with rocks

C24.question: 北投有很多什麼？
C24.why: A steaming pool among rocks → 溫泉. A and C do not match.

C24.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
C24.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.

lines.zh: 新聞說颱風的中心在南方，台北大概不會下雨。

C24.question: 台北明天大概會怎麼樣？
C24.why: 台北大概不會下雨. A is the opposite; C: the typhoon's centre is in the south.

C24.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the picture that answers the question.

lines.zh: 從這裡走路去，大概二十分鐘。
要是走路太遠的話，我們可以坐公車嗎？

C24.question: 坐公車去溫泉要多久？
C24.why: 公車十分鐘就到. A is on foot. C is not mentioned.

C24.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
C24.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the most suitable answer.

lines.zh: 等冬天吧，冬天去溫泉最舒服。

C24.question: 這位先生覺得什麼時候去溫泉比較好？
C24.why: 冬天去溫泉最舒服. A and B are rejected (太熱). D is not mentioned.

C24.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
C24.text: 颱風來了的話，學校就不上課了。
C24.why: 颱風 + 不上課 → no school. A has no typhoon; B still has school.

C24.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
C24.why: Spring flowers, a mild temperature → 春季很舒服. A and C are other seasons.

C24.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
C24.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
C24.why: 往北 → 方向 (direction). 地點 = location (it doesn't 'move'); 度 is for temperature.

C24.instr: Fill in each blank. Each option can be used only once, and ONE option is not used.
C24.text: 我們本來想這個週末去北投的（1）。可是新聞說，有一個颱風（2）會在星期六到台灣。要是颱風真的來了，（3）。老師說，颱風天別出門，因為風雨很大。我們決定下個星期再去，（4）跟時間都不變。希望到時候天氣好，只有二十（5），去溫泉最舒服。
C24.why: 泡溫泉; 颱風大概星期六到; 要是…就不去了; 地點跟時間都不變; 二十度左右. 「往這個方向走」 doesn't fit any blank.

C24.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
C24.text: 颱風來的時候，要注意什麼？第一，不要去山上或是海邊。第二，家裡要準備水和吃的東西，要夠用三天。第三，要是住的房子很舊，應該先去朋友家或是附近的活動中心住，等颱風走了再回家。
C24.question: 住在舊房子的人，颱風來的時候應該怎麼做？
C24.why: 房子很舊 → 先去朋友家或活動中心住. A & D: forbidden (不要去山上或是海邊). B: the opposite for old houses.

C28.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: he holds his head in pain

C28.question: 你哪裡不舒服？
C28.why: Holding his head → 頭痛. A and B are other body parts.

C28.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: she is sweating heavily after running in the sun

C28.question: 他怎麼了？
C28.why: Running in the hot sun → 流汗. A and C do not match.

C28.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
C28.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.
C28.question: 藥怎麼了？
C28.why: 被我的狗吃掉了. A and B are not mentioned.

C28.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the picture that answers the question.

lines.zh: 醫生，我一直咳嗽，也流鼻水。
不發燒，可是晚上咳得不能睡覺。

C28.question: 這位先生哪裡不舒服？
C28.why: 咳嗽 + 流鼻水. A is ruled out (不發燒). C is not mentioned.

C28.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
C28.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the most suitable answer.

lines.zh: 好多了，只是還有一點咳。
醫生說最好再休息兩天。

C28.question: 這位先生明天可能怎麼做？
C28.why: 最好再休息兩天 → rest. A is the invitation he politely turns down. C and D are not mentioned.

C28.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
C28.text: 弟弟被這個感冒弄得很累，一直在床上。
C28.why: 被感冒弄得很累 + 在床上. A and B do not match.

C28.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
C28.why: Sneezing / runny nose → 流鼻水. A and C do not match.

C28.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
C28.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
C28.text: 他的病很（　），醫生讓他在醫院住幾天。
C28.why: 病很嚴重 = the illness is serious. 病很發燒 and 病很咳嗽 are ungrammatical.

C28.instr: Fill in each blank. Each option can be used only once, and ONE option is not used.
C28.text: 這幾天天氣一下冷一下熱，我感冒了。一開始只是（1），後來又開始（2），晚上咳得沒辦法睡覺。昨天晚上我（3），三十九度，衣服上都是（4）。我本來想吃上次沒吃完的感冒藥，可是發現藥（5）了！室友說我病得很嚴重，今天早上就陪我去看醫生了。
C28.why: First: 流鼻水; then 咳嗽; 發燒三十九度; 衣服上都是汗; the medicine 被弟弟吃掉了. 「吃得很多」 doesn't fit any blank.

C28.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
C28.text: 感冒的時候，很多人覺得多流汗就會好，所以穿很多衣服，還去運動。醫生說這樣不對。如果發燒了，流太多汗，身體會更累，病也不容易好。感冒的時候應該多喝水、多休息。要是咳嗽很嚴重，或是發燒三天還沒好，就一定要去看醫生。
C28.question: 醫生覺得感冒的時候應該怎麼做？
C28.why: 應該多喝水、多休息. A & B: opinions said to be 不對. D: the doctor says a fever that lasts THREE days without getting better…

C40.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: a night market packed with people

C40.question: 夜市怎麼樣？
C40.why: A night market full of people → 熱鬧. A is the opposite; C is not shown.

C40.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: shoes a bit tight on the feet

C40.question: 這雙鞋子怎麼樣？
C40.why: The shoes are a bit tight → 小了一點. A is the opposite; B does not match.

C40.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
C40.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.

lines.zh: 上個星期打九折，今天打七折。

C40.question: 那家店今天打幾折？
C40.why: 今天打七折. A was last week. C is not mentioned.

C40.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the picture that answers the question.

lines.zh: 百貨公司今天打折，可是人一定很多。
那我們去夜市吧，比較熱鬧，也比較便宜。

C40.question: 他們要去哪裡？
C40.why: 那我們去夜市吧. A is mentioned but too crowded. C is not mentioned.

C40.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
C40.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the most suitable answer.

lines.zh: 你怎麼買了三件一樣的衣服？
今天打五折，一件才三百塊。
一件給我，一件給我姊姊，一件給我媽媽。

C40.question: 這位小姐為什麼買三件？
C40.why: 一件給我，一件給姊姊，一件給媽媽 → for her family. B is the situation, not the reason for three. A and D are not mentioned.

C40.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
C40.text: 店門口有很多人在排隊。
C40.why: 很多人在排隊. A and C have no queue.

C40.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
C40.why: Clothes too big → 大了一點. A is the opposite; B is not shown.

C40.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
C40.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
C40.why: 去逛街 = go shopping. 去排隊 and 去打折 are not normal weekend activities.

C40.instr: Fill in each blank. Each option can be used only once, and ONE option is not used.
C40.text: 這個週末百貨公司打（1），所以我和姊姊一早就去（2）。百貨公司裡人很多，（3）得不得了。有一家店的衣服打五折，門口有很多人在（4）。我們等了半個小時才進去。衣服一件（5）便宜，我們買了好幾件。
C40.why: 打八折; 去逛街; 熱鬧得不得了; 門口排隊; 一件比一件便宜. 「貴得不得了」 contradicts the sale.

C40.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
C40.text: 每年十月，台北的百貨公司都會打折，很多東西打七折、八折，有的還打五折。所以每到這個時候，百貨公司就熱鬧得不得了，大家都排隊買東西。可是也有人說，打折的時候大家常常買了很多不需要的東西，好像少花了錢，可是花得更多。
C40.question: 有人覺得打折的時候怎麼樣？
C40.why: 買了很多不需要的東西…其實花得更多. A: the opposite of that opinion. C: the opposite (熱鬧). D: not mentioned.

C58.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: the exam over, he stretches with relief

C58.question: 考完試，你覺得怎麼樣？
C58.why: Stretching with relief → 輕鬆. A and C do not match.

C58.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

picture.label: she's amazed by a beautiful view

C58.question: 她說什麼？
C58.why: Amazed by the view → 哇！好漂亮. A and B do not match.

C58.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
C58.instr: Listen to the short exchange, then choose the matching picture.

lines.zh: 不只錢多，而且離家很近。

C58.question: 這位小姐覺得新工作怎麼樣？

options.label: good pay and close to home

C58.why: 不只…而且… → both. A and C are only one.

C58.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the picture that answers the question.
C58.question: 這位先生為什麼心情不好？
C58.why: 我的狗生病了. A and B are not mentioned.

C58.part: 聽力 Part 4 · Dialogue + implied meaning
C58.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the most suitable answer.

lines.zh: 我媽媽教我的，你覺得怎麼樣？

C58.question: 這位先生覺得菜怎麼樣？
C58.why: 不但好看，而且好吃. A and B are partly the opposite. D is the opposite.

C58.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
C58.text: 她今天心情很好，一直在笑。
C58.why: 心情很好 + 一直在笑. A and C are the opposite.

C58.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
options: 沒想到大家給我辦了派對！
C58.why: A surprise party → 沒想到…派對. A and B do not match.

C58.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
C58.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
C58.why: 心情很輕鬆 = feel relaxed. 不但 and 沒想到 cannot be predicates.

C58.instr: Fill in each blank. Each option can be used only once, and ONE option is not used.
C58.text: 昨天是我的生日，可是我要上班，所以（1）不太好。下班回家，我一打開門，朋友們都在我家，大聲說「生日快樂」！我（2）他們會來，（3），他們（4）來了，而且還帶了蛋糕和禮物。那天晚上我們聊天、唱歌，大家都玩得（5）。
C58.why: 心情不太好; 沒想到他們會來; 哇 = an exclamation of surprise; 不但…而且; 玩得非常開心. 「感覺很輕鬆」 doesn't fit any blank.

C58.instr: Read the text, then choose the most suitable answer.
C58.text: 小王以前每個週末都有很多事要做，不但要爬山，而且還要跟朋友吃飯、看電影，星期一上班的時候更累了。後來他試著週末只做一件事，其他時間在家看書、休息。沒想到他的心情變好了，上班也更有精神了。他說，週末輕鬆一點，感覺好多了。
C58.question: 小王後來發現什麼？
C58.why: 週末輕鬆一點，感覺好多了. A: the opposite. C: lots of activities actually make you tired. D: not mentioned.
